tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Search checked saunas, Nordic spas and bathhouses in Ontario and Quebec (Canada). Prices are the venue's own published adult day-pass prices in CAD. Filter by city or region, budget, guest age and facilities.

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Full checked record for one place by slug: prices, what the pass includes, age rule, swimsuit rule, quiet rules, time limit, facilities, sources and check date.

tools.name: get_booking_links
tools.description: Links to book a visit, buy a gift card, visit the venue's site, or find a nearby stay. Some stay links are affiliate links; they never affect search order.
